create_starlette_app: create a Starlette app for the dataset search service reading config from environment variables
create_app_with_config: create a Starlette app with a given AppConfig setting up middleware resources and routes
start_uvicorn_server: start the uvicorn ASGI server running the search service on the configured host and port
review_create_app_with_config: review the create_app_with_config function and its middleware resource and route setup
refactor_search_routes: refactor the search and filter route creation to reduce duplicated endpoint parameters
